title: PAR-07/S8 DataIndex target segment-kind guard
scope: Require the header DataIndex reference to identify a DataIndex segment
Ensure a wrong-kind segment is rejected before DataIndex entries or record associations are exposed
Update the open-source parity plan with the completed local slice

localCodeInspection: src/drw_datastorage.cpp::readSchemaIndex already validates the referenced segment kind, while readDataIndex previously accepted any in-range segment
tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp::testDataStorageRecordCountAlignmentAnchors generates the four-record AC1027 DataStorage section and owns the header/index/payload boundary assertions
method.limitations: The generated wrong-kind case establishes local parser role validation and fail-closed exposure only. It does not establish arbitrary producer compatibility, complete DataStorage conformance, ACIS validity, kernel semantics, or native consumer acceptance.

formatBasis.authority: The header's data-index reference is interpreted according to DataStorage segment roles and the documented DataIndex lookup chain; peer behavior is not the expected-value oracle.
formatBasis.expectedDisposition: A header reference that resolves to a non-DataIndex segment is structurally invalid and must not be parsed as DataIndex rows or used to expose records.

behavior: readDataIndex now emits datastorage-data-index-kind-invalid and returns when the header target is not classified as a DataIndex segment.
The generated four-record AC1027 case redirects the header DataIndex slot to the segment-index segment and verifies structural invalidity, non-replayability, and empty DataIndex/record exposure.
The generated profile restores its positive DataIndex slot before the separate payload-region boundary mutation.

decision.nextAction: Self-unblock to the next source-backed local PAR-07/S8 invariant; keep independent semantics and native consumers at their composed gates.
